description: Backend application layer: Form Requests, CourtService (with transaction, spatie court-owner role auto-grant, owner-scope guards, status transitions, image upload/delete), CourtController (owner CRUD), AdminController court-approval methods, bilingual i18n keys, routes/api.php wiring, and PHPUnit unit+feature tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (enums/models/repository).
steps: Create app/Http/Requests/CourtCreateOrUpdateRequest.php (authorize(): true). In rules(), compute $isUpdate = $this->route('courtId') !== null. courtName: required on create / sometimes|nullable on update, string max 254. courtDescription nullable string. courtModalityId required|integer|exists:modalities,id. courtCityId required|integer|exists:cities,id. courtAddressLine nullable|string|max:500. courtSurfaceType required|in:natural,sintetico,emborrachado,piso. contacts required|array|min:1; contacts.*.type required|in:whatsapp,phone,other; contacts.*.value required|string|max:255; contacts.*.label nullable|string|max:100. photos: on create required|array|min:1|max:10 and photos.* image|max:10240; on update photos nullable|array and photos.* image|max:10240. removedPhotoIds nullable|array; removedPhotoIds.* integer. pricingRules nullable|array; each weekday integer between 0 and 6 (support an array of weekdays expanded to rows — accept pricingRules.*.weekday integer between:0,6), startTime/endTime date_format:H:i with endTime after startTime, priceCents integer min:0. scheduleConfigs nullable|array; scheduleConfigs.*.weekday integer between:0,6; scheduleConfigs.*.isActive boolean; when isActive is true require startTime/endTime (H:i, end after start) and reservationDuration in:60,90,120 and enforce window fits one slot (end-start minutes >= reservationDuration), when isActive is false those are nullable and the slot-fit check is skipped. Add a withValidator()/after hook to: (a) reject duplicate weekday in scheduleConfigs payload, (b) enforce the combined photo count rule on UPDATE: (existingKept - removed) + newUploads must be between 1 and 10 — fetch the court's current photo ids via CourtRepository/model, subtract removedPhotoIds, add count(photos); fail with message __('error.court.photos_range'). On create enforce 1..10 purely via the photos array rule.

Create app/Service/CourtService.php (extends BaseService; constructor injects CourtRepository and UploadService). createCourt(array $data): wrap in DB::transaction(function(){...}): build court row with user_id=Auth::id(), slug=Str::slug(name), status defaults to pending (NEVER take status from input), persist via repository->create(); write children with the Court hasMany relations' createMany() (contacts, pricingRules, scheduleConfigs); upload each photos[] file via uploadService->uploadFileToFolder('public','courts',$file) and store the returned folder-prefixed path verbatim as court_photos.photo_path with incrementing position; then if (! $user->hasRole('court-owner')) { $role = Role::firstOrCreate(['name'=>'court-owner','guard_name'=>'web']); $user->assignRole($role); }. On any exception inside the transaction, best-effort delete any files already written (uploadService->deleteFileOnFolder('public','courts', basename($path))), Log::error with context, and rethrow so the DB rolls back (surface as 500 __('error.court.upload_failed') or generic).

updateCourt(array $data, int $courtId): FIRST $court = repository->firstOwnedById($courtId, Auth::id()); if null throw with 404 __('error.court.not_found') (or 403 __('error.court.not_owner') when the row exists but belongs to someone else — a dedicated firstById check distinguishes them). Only then, inside DB::transaction: update scalar fields via repository->updateById (safe now that ownership is verified); replace children by soft-deleting removedPhotoIds photos (delete files with basename($path)), appending new uploaded photos, and syncing contacts/pricingRules/scheduleConfigs (delete existing + createMany from payload is acceptable). Never write status here (strip it).

getMyCourts(): repository->myCourts(Auth::id()). getOwnedDetail(int $courtId): repository->getOwnedDetail($courtId, Auth::id()); null => 404/403 as above. delete(int $courtId): owner-scope fetch then soft delete. approve(int $courtId): fetch (admin, no user scope); require current status pending|rejected else throw 409 __('error.court.invalid_status_transition'); set status=approved, approved_at=now(), approved_by=Auth::id(). reject(int $courtId, ?string $reason): require current status pending|approved else 409; set status=rejected, rejection_reason=$reason.

Create app/Http/Controllers/CourtController.php (constructor injects CourtService + CourtRepository). myCourts() => json(['courts'=>$service->getMyCourts()],200). show(int $courtId) => $court = $service->getOwnedDetail($courtId); json($court,200). save(CourtCreateOrUpdateRequest $request, int $courtId = null) => if $courtId update else create; return json(__('messages.court.updated'|'created'), 201). destroy(int $courtId) => $service->delete; json(__('messages.court.deleted'),200). Map thrown exceptions to their HTTP codes consistent with TeamService (throw_if with Response::HTTP_* status codes, caught by the framework handler).

Add admin methods to the EXISTING app/Http/Controllers/AdminController.php (do NOT create a new controller): courts(Request $request) => $filters = $request->only(['status','modality_id','state_id','city_id']); $perPage=(int)$request->query('per_page',15); json($this->adminRepository->getPaginatedCourts($filters,$perPage),200). showCourt(int $courtId) => json(detail from CourtRepository->getDetailForAdmin or 404,200). approveCourt(int $courtId) => delegate CourtService->approve; json(__('messages.court.approved'),200). rejectCourt(CourtRejectRequest $request, int $courtId) => delegate CourtService->reject($courtId, $request->validated()['reason'] ?? null); json(__('messages.court.rejected'),200). Inject CourtService into AdminController's constructor alongside the existing AdminRepository.

Add i18n keys to ALL FOUR files, keeping pt_BR and en in sync. lang/pt_BR/error.php and lang/en/error.php: a 'court' group with not_found, not_owner, upload_failed, invalid_status_transition, photos_range. lang/pt_BR/messages.php and lang/en/messages.php: a 'court' group with created, updated, deleted, approved, rejected.

Wire routes in routes/api.php. Inside the existing Route::middleware('auth:api')->group add a group: Route::prefix('court')->name('court.')->controller(CourtController::class)->group(function(){ Route::get('my-courts','myCourts'); Route::get('show/{courtId}','show'); Route::post('save','save')->middleware('emailVerified'); Route::post('update/{courtId}','save'); Route::delete('delete/{courtId}','destroy'); }); Add the court import at top. Inside the EXISTING Route::prefix('admin')->middleware('isAdmin')->controller(AdminController::class)->group add: Route::get('/courts','courts'); Route::get('/courts/{courtId}','showCourt'); Route::post('/courts/{courtId}/approve','approveCourt'); Route::post('/courts/{courtId}/reject','rejectCourt');

Add tests. tests/Unit/CourtServiceTest.php: role granted once and idempotent on a second court (Storage::fake('public')); DB rollback leaves no court when a photo upload throws (mock UploadService to throw); approve/reject status-transition guards throw on illegal transitions. tests/Feature/CourtOwnerFlowTest.php (RefreshDatabase, Sanctum::actingAs($user), Storage::fake('public')): POST court/save creates a court with status pending and assigns the court-owner role; 0 photos and 11 photos and missing contact and bad surface and duplicate schedule weekday each return 422; GET court/show/{id} by a non-owner returns 403; admin approve sets status/approved_by, admin reject sets status/rejection_reason; a non-admin hitting admin/courts gets 403. Authenticate with Sanctum::actingAs — never Passport.
acceptance_criteria: `php artisan test` passes including the new CourtServiceTest and CourtOwnerFlowTest.
`php artisan route:list --path=court` lists my-courts/show/save/update/delete; `php artisan route:list --path=admin/courts` lists the four admin routes.
Creating a first court assigns the spatie 'court-owner' role (guard web) and the court starts status=pending; owner save/update never writes status.
Non-owner access to a court returns 403; unknown id returns 404; illegal admin status transitions return 409; photo-count/validation violations return 422.
court-owner role grant and all child writes occur within a single DB transaction that rolls back on failure.
verification: Run `php artisan test` and confirm all tests pass.
Run `php artisan route:list --path=court` and `php artisan route:list --path=admin/courts` and confirm the routes are registered.
findings:
COMPLETED. All 17 Court tests pass; the only suite failures are the 8 pre-existing Tests\Feature\PaymentMethodFlowTest cases (team_players.game_position_id NOT NULL fixture bug) documented by FEAT-001 as unrelated. Routes verified via route:list (9 under /court incl. the 4 admin, 4 under admin/courts).

FRONTEND CONTRACT (match these exactly):

OWNER ROUTES (prefix api/court, guard auth:api, names court.*):
  GET    court/my-courts            -> {"courts": Court[]}  (each: photos[], modality_info, city_info.state_info)
  GET    court/show/{courtId}       -> Court detail (contacts, photos, pricing_rules, schedule_configs, modality_info, city_info.state_info); 403 error.court.not_owner if the court exists but is another user's, 404 error.court.not_found if unknown.
  POST   court/save                 -> 201 with a plain string body = messages.court.created. middleware emailVerified. multipart/form-data.
  POST   court/update/{courtId}     -> 201 plain string = messages.court.updated. multipart/form-data (use POST + _method or plain POST; route is POST).
  DELETE court/delete/{courtId}     -> 200 plain string = messages.court.deleted.

ADMIN ROUTES (prefix api/admin, guard isAdmin, on AdminController):
  GET    admin/courts               -> LengthAwarePaginator of courts; query filters status (DEFAULTS to 'pending' when absent/empty), modality_id, state_id, city_id, per_page (1..100, default 15); each row has owner{id,name}, modality_info, city_info.state_info, photos_count.
  GET    admin/courts/{courtId}     -> admin detail (same eager load + owner); 404 {"error": error.court.not_found}.
  POST   admin/courts/{courtId}/approve -> 200 plain string messages.court.approved; 409 error.court.invalid_status_transition unless current status is pending|rejected; sets status=approved, approved_at, approved_by.
  POST   admin/courts/{courtId}/reject  -> body {reason?: string<=1000}; 200 plain string messages.court.rejected; 409 unless current status is pending|approved; sets status=rejected, rejection_reason.

REQUEST FIELD NAMES (CourtCreateOrUpdateRequest, camelCase inputs):
  courtName (required on create / sometimes|nullable on update, max 254), courtDescription (nullable), courtModalityId (required int exists:modalities,id), courtCityId (required int exists:cities,id), courtAddressLine (nullable max 500), courtSurfaceType (required in: natural|sintetico|emborrachado|piso).
  contacts[] (required min 1): {type in whatsapp|phone|other, value string<=255, label? string<=100}.
  photos[] (CREATE required 1..10, each image max 10240KB; UPDATE nullable array, combined (kept-removed)+new must stay within 1..10 or 422 error.court.photos_range).
  removedPhotoIds[] (nullable int[], UPDATE only).
  pricingRules[] (nullable): {weekday 0..6, startTime 'H:i', endTime 'H:i' after start, priceCents int>=0}.
  scheduleConfigs[] (nullable): {weekday 0..6, isActive bool; when isActive true require startTime/endTime 'H:i' (end>start) + reservationDuration in 60|90|120 and (end-start minutes)>=duration; when false those are nulled}. Duplicate weekday in payload => 422 error.court.duplicate_schedule_weekday.

STATUS VALUES: pending | approved | rejected. SURFACE: natural|sintetico|emborrachado|piso. RESERVATION DURATION: 60|90|120.

ROLE: first created court grants spatie role 'court-owner' (guard web) idempotently inside the create transaction; owner save/update never writes status.

i18n KEYS added to all four files: error.court.{not_found,not_owner,upload_failed,invalid_status_transition,photos_range,duplicate_schedule_weekday,schedule_window_required,schedule_window_invalid}; messages.court.{created,updated,deleted,approved,rejected}. (The first five error keys were the mandated set; the extra three support the schedule-config validation hook.)

TEST ENV NOTE: CLI PHP 8.5 lacks dom/xml/xmlwriter/sqlite extensions and GD. Tests were run with PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR=/etc/php/8.5/cli/conf.d:/tmp/phpext-ini (an ini dir loading the extracted .so files in order xml,xmlwriter,dom,xmlreader,simplexml,sqlite3,pdo_sqlite). Because GD is absent, the feature test builds fake uploads with UploadedFile::fake()->create(name,size,'image/jpeg') instead of ->image(). Feature tests authenticate with Sanctum::actingAs($user, ['*'], 'api') — the explicit 'api' guard is required since routes use auth:api; still Sanctum, never Passport.
